verses.text: David and the army commanders also set apart some of the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun for a special service. They were to prophesy while playing harps, lyres, and cymbals. This is the list of the men who did this work:
From the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. They were under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied under the king's direction.

From the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six in all. They were under the direction of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the harp, giving thanks and praise to the LORD.
From the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
All these were the sons of Heman, the king's seer. God had promised to make him strong, and God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

All these men were under the direction of their fathers for the music in the LORD's temple. They played cymbals, lyres, and harps for the service of God's temple. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were under the king's direction.
They and their relatives were all trained and skilled in singing to the LORD. There were two hundred and eighty-eight of them.
They all drew lots for their duties, young and old alike, teacher and student alike.
The first lot, for Asaph, fell to Joseph. The second fell to Gedaliah, with his relatives and sons, twelve in all.
The third fell to Zaccur, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The fourth fell to Izri, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The fifth fell to Nethaniah, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The sixth fell to Bukkiah, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The seventh fell to Jesharelah, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The eighth fell to Jeshaiah, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The ninth fell to Mattaniah, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The tenth fell to Shimei, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The eleventh fell to Azarel, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The twelfth fell to Hashabiah, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The thirteenth fell to Shubael, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The fourteenth fell to Mattithiah, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The fifteenth fell to Jeremoth, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The sixteenth fell to Hananiah, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The seventeenth fell to Joshbekashah, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The eighteenth fell to Hanani, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The nineteenth fell to Mallothi, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The twentieth fell to Eliathah, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The twenty-first fell to Hothir, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The twenty-second fell to Giddalti, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The twenty-third fell to Mahazioth, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
The twenty-fourth fell to Romamti-Ezer, with his sons and relatives, twelve in all.
